items.quote: Patients repeatedly mention cooperative doctors, supportive staff and a clean, well-managed hospital environment for eye treatment.
Ahmedabad patient stories call out doctor friendliness, treatment satisfaction and clear explanations during LASIK and cataract visits.
Bharuch feedback commonly praises safe eye-care service, good staff behaviour and helpful support through every stage of the visit.
Families in north Ahmedabad mention no longer crossing the city for an eye check-up, now that a hospital is nearby.
Patients from across Sabarkantha mention getting surgical advice and treatment here rather than travelling to Ahmedabad for it.
Patients mention a welcoming front desk, clear directions between rooms and staff who take time over every question.
Surgery patients highlight smooth processes, guidance before and after treatment, and care-team follow-up after returning home.
Families note that charges are explained before treatment begins, so the amount discussed at counselling is the amount they settle.
Review visits are fixed before discharge, and patients mention reminder calls from the hospital team when a check-up is due.
Patients describe unhurried examinations, with each test explained as it is done and time left at the end for questions.
Families bringing elderly parents mention staff who walk them through registration, tests and eye drops at a patient pace.
Patients mention having their new prescription made up at the optical counter on the same visit, without a second trip.

notes: Every quote is a summarised review theme, never a verbatim patient quote. Legacy testimonial spam was intentionally excluded.
`branch` is a slug from branches.json; the card prints that hospital's name, and an item whose slug matches no hospital is dropped.

Order is reading order: the phone rail plays the list top to bottom, and wider screens split it into two rows at the halfway point - so keep one theme per hospital in each half, in the site's hospital order, and no hospital's two themes ever sit side by side.
Sourced from public reviews: Visnagar 'Staff support' and 'Surgery guidance', Ahmedabad 'Doctor communication', Bharuch 'Safe care'.

Drafted, not sourced, and needing the hospital's sign-off before launch: Ahmedabad 'Clear costs', Bharuch 'Follow-up care', and both themes for Gota, Himmatnagar and Juhapura. No public review text for Himmatnagar or Juhapura could be found (Gota shows a Justdial rating but no readable reviews); replace these with themes from each hospital's own Google reviews.
